infoLinks.urlText: L4 Westmead and Carlingford Line partial closure during Parramatta Lanes
infoLinks.content:
Wednesday 21 to Saturday 24 October
  • Due to road closures and for pedestrian safety during Parramatta Lanes, L4 Westmead and Carlingford Line light rail services will not run between Westmead and Parramatta square during the following times:
  • 5pm to 11pm on Wednesday 21 and Thursday 22 October
  • 5pm to 11.30 pm on Friday 23 and Saturday 24 October
  • Light rail services will continue to run between Parramatta Square and Carlingford.
  • During this time, use alternative transport including trains, regular bus services, L4 replacement bus services or walking if able to, between Westmead and Parramatta Square.
 
L4 replacement bus services
  • Replacement bus services will run every 7 to 10 minutes from:
  • 5pm to 11pm on Wednesday 21 and Thursday 22 October
  • 5pm to 11.30pm on Friday 23 and Saturday 24 October.
  • These times may vary depending on road traffic.

Replacement buses will not stop at the following locations
  • Westmead Hospital. Please use alternative stop at Westmead Station (about 6 minutes walk).
  • Ngara. Please use the alternative stop at Benaud Oval (about 5 minutes walk).
  • Most replacement buses will be accessible; if not, wait for the next service.


  • Allow extra travel time and use the Trip Planner or check travel alerts to see if your travel is affected.
  • Check signs at stops and see the event page for more information.

infoLinks.urlText: Extra L2 and L3 light rail services run during train trackwork in the City
infoLinks.content:
Friday 23 to Sunday 25 October
 
  • From 10.40pm Friday, train trackwork on the City Circle and T1 North Shore Line may affect how you travel.
  • Trains do not run between Central and Wynyard, or on the City Circle.
  • Use light rail services between Central and Circular Quay.
  • For travel to T1 North Shore Line stations change at Wynyard.

  • Saturday and Sunday, daily from 7am to 7pm, extra L2 and L3 light rail services run between Circular Quay and Randwick or Juniors Kingsford.

  • Plan your trip before you travel for up-to-date real time information. You can also subscribe to train and metro planned trackwork alerts.
